mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are enjoying mainly clear skies and a comfortable 73 degrees around Badger Prairie County Park.

In city developments, the Plan Commission will meet on Wednesday, November 4th to review several projects, including the 80-lot Ardent Glen addition and site plans for Milky Way and Sub-Zero. Also, residents should note that property tax bills will be mailed by December 15th.

For local events, check out live music happening today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out yoga at Insight Wellness, and mark your calendars for the Main Street Trick Or Treat at Hometown Junction Park on October 29th.

In law enforcement news, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for an O W I on Thursday afternoon near Whalen Road after receiving reports of dangerous driving. No injuries were reported.
Rounding out today, Culver's is open until 10 PM tonight serving up Snickers Swirl as their flavor of the day. Tomorrow's flavor will be Pumpkin Pecan.
